test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Delay an event to a later date or time
solution:
The correct answer is **'Postpone'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Postpone'** means to arrange that something will happen at a later time than the time you had planned; to delay.

 **-Example:** The match was postponed because of rain.

So it is clear that **'Postpone'** can be used as a one-word substitute for **'Delay an event to a later date or time.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prepone** means to change the time or date of an event so that it takes place earlier; to advance something.

 
 
• **Example**: The government might **prepone **these elections so we'd better be prepared.
 
 
 
• **Preserve** means to keep something safe or in good condition.
 
 
• **Example**: The agreement **preserved **our right to limit trade in endangered species.
 
 
 
• **Persevere** means to continue trying to do or achieve something that is difficult.​
 
 
• **Example**: We will **persevere **in this struggle for peace, no matter how long it takes.
